subject: Web Development
title: React: UI as a Function
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on React: UI as a Function.

hook.text: In 2013, Facebook open-sourced React. Developers called it crazy at first.

buildup.text: React mixed HTML inside JavaScript with JSX. Purists said it violated separation of concerns.

discovery.text: The Virtual DOM diffed changes and updated only what needed to change — fast and predictable.

twist.text: React didn't try to be a full framework. It was just a view library — and that was enough.

climax.text: React's component model became the default way the industry builds web interfaces.

punchline.text: A 'crazy' idea became the industry standard.

quiz.question: What did React introduce for efficient DOM updates?
